best_opportunities.project: TIWI DISASTER AI (Supply, Delivery, Installation, Integration, Training, Testing and Commissioning of an Integrated Disaster Intelligence, Unified Command Hazard Monitoring Risk Reduction Management Platform for the Municipal Government of Tiwi, Albay)
best_opportunities.deadline: Header closing date: September 8, 2026 5:00 PM; description says short-listing documents due on or before September 3, 2026 at the BAC Office
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Public Bidding / Request for Expression of Interest
best_opportunities.why_fit: This remains the clearest capability match for AIStaff's custom AI systems, automated notifications, dashboards, and workflow orchestration. The notice explicitly names AI and an integrated disaster-intelligence platform rather than generic software alone.
important_requirements: Short-listing documents due under pass/fail eligibility screening
Bidding restricted to Filipino citizens, sole proprietorships, cooperatives, partnerships, or organizations with at least 60% Filipino ownership
Contract duration stated as fifteen (15) days
BAC contact: Sharmaine Kristine R. Carlet / Ma. Yvonne C. Domanais, LGU-Tiwi, lgutiwibac@gmail.com, 0946-573-4974
Public abstract does not clearly state whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable; confirm in the bidding documents or DRL
risks_or_blockers: The notice changed materially from the previous run: the header now shows a September 8, 2026 5:00 PM closing date instead of the earlier September 3 timing, while the body still says short-listing documents are due on September 3, 2026
The fifteen-day contract duration is extremely aggressive for a real integrated platform and may indicate a narrower or differently staged scope
The public abstract does not expose the detailed short-listing criteria, prior-experience requirements, or precise PhilGEPS registration level requirement
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Call or email the BAC immediately to confirm which date controls, request the exact short-listing checklist, and verify whether the scope is full deployment, pilot rollout, or a phased delivery with later implementation.

best_opportunities.project: Installation of Updated Human Resource Management System for the Office of Human Resource Management Gumaca Quezon
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34) / RFQ
best_opportunities.why_fit: This is a practical custom-system deployment with a small-value procurement route, a limited module set, and a 60-day duration. It is not AI-specific, but it fits AIStaff's systems and workflow-automation service line better than most commodity IT postings.
important_requirements: Scope shown in the public abstract: user access control, employee records, DTR management, leave administration, travel orders, and report generation
BAC contact: Shiela Marie Cortez Grantoza, gumacabac@gmail.com, (042) 317-8113
Public abstract does not list the full eligibility-document checklist or PhilGEPS membership level requirement
No explicit prior-government-project requirement is visible in the public abstract
risks_or_blockers: The scope is HRMS-focused rather than AI-led, so the fit depends on AIStaff positioning this as a workflow-system build rather than a packaged AI product sale
Because the public abstract is short, the real implementation depth, deployment expectations, and acceptance requirements may only appear in attachments or the RFQ packet
The notice does not explicitly confirm whether Red PhilGEPS registration is sufficient
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request the RFQ packet and implementation checklist immediately, then decide whether AIStaff can quote a lean HRMS deployment without overcommitting on payroll-grade features or deep government HR compliance modules.

not_recommended.project: NEGO-PROCUREMENT OF CENTRALIZED LEGISLATIVE AND ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT AND TRACKING SYSTEM FOR SANGGUNIANG BAYAN, LOS BANOS, LAGUNA
not_recommended.reason: The title is attractive because it includes AI assistant integration and speech-to-text, but the public scope is dominated by server infrastructure, network hardware, Wi-Fi rollout, on-prem deployment, domain integration, and a large integrated delivery package under a two-failed-biddings route. That makes it too hardware-heavy and too operationally broad for a clean AIStaff first-government bid.

not_recommended.project: Procurement of Consulting Services for the BCDA Strategic Communications and Developmental Advocacy Program
not_recommended.procuring_entity: Bases Conversion and Development Authority - Main
not_recommended.reason: This is a one-year public-bidding communications consultancy using shortlist criteria that emphasize relevant consultant experience, key personnel, and current workload. It is closer to a traditional institutional communications-retainer engagement than to AIStaff's Brandee or automation work, and the compliance burden is high.

not_recommended.project: OCM-26-CS-023 CONSULTING SERVICES FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE BRAND STRATEGY, OFFICIAL THEME, AND TAGLINE FOR THE 2027 PALARONG PAMBANSA
not_recommended.reason: This is a straightforward branding-strategy engagement. Even though the procurement mode is small value, the public notice points to conventional campaign-branding work rather than AI-led content operations, chatbot/voice work, or a systems build.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: Installation of Updated Human Resource Management System for the Office of Human Resource Management Gumaca Quezon (Ref 13212827) is the most actionable opportunity today; TIWI DISASTER AI (Ref 13211679) is the strongest capability fit but has higher compliance and scope ambiguity.
